static_traits.name: Fang Jie
static_traits.social_status: Relationship with friends affected, tense from constantly seeking recognition for Work achievements; Having a few supportive friends, but finding it hard to open up to them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never received psychotherapy in the past; repeatedly experiencing feelings of failure and not-good-enough when projects fall short of expectations
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, highly cooperative (willing to try reality testing and gratitude exercises), able to self-observe; speed of speech Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: I am struggling with feelings of failure and not-good-enough, despite having built some successful websites. These feelings have persisted for the past few years. The latest website project underperformed expectations, intensifying my doubts and stress, making me constantly question my abilities. I experience these negative feelings when starting new projects or seeing others' success in the field, often dwelling on unsuccessful websites and feeling like a professional failure.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these persistent feelings of failure are affecting my motivation and preventing me from effectively starting new projects.
growth_experiences: Over the past few years, whenever a project fell short of expectations, feelings of failure and not-good-enough repeatedly appeared; the usual coping is to immediately start a new project, hoping the next success will change the feelings, but the cycle repeats.
Entered the web development industry through Self-study, with professional skills and experience mainly from personal practice and project accumulation.

core_beliefs: I am a failure/not competent enough
My success is only luck; failure is what reflects my real ability
If the project is not continuously successful, it proves I have no value

special_situations.event: The latest website project falling short of expected performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the project does not meet expectations, it proves my abilities are insufficient and I am a professional failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately starts a new project, trying to prove herself through the next success; at the same time postpones current work to avoid failing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for this field; I am just a failure

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot ensure the new project's success, I will again be proven not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating on tasks, repeated Self-doubt, to avoid making mistakes; constantly seeking outside approval before starting

special_situations.event: Seeing peers or others succeed in the same field
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' success means I am falling behind, I am not as good as others
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly seeking recognition of one's work from friends; focusing attention on one's own shortcomings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all better than me; I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When reviewing one's project performance, only focusing on unsuccessful cases
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only comprehensive and sustained success counts as qualified; any failure Undoes all achievements
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores positive feedback and successful experiences, focusing attention on mistakes and problems
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My successes were all luck; the real me is just not capable

core_conflict.wish: Desires recognition and affirmation of one's professional value
core_conflict.fear: Fearing exposing shortcomings, being negated or seen as incompetent
defense_goal: Maintains control over evaluation through self-criticism and attributing failure to oneself
Staying cautious and distant (procrastinating, not readily showing work) to lower the risk of criticism
Temporarily relieving unease by seeking outside validation

object_relations.object_representation: Picky judges (others or the market will define me by failure)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the reasons for the project failure, or when facing negative feedback on the project from others/data
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to see negative results entirely as one's own problem, believing others will negate oneself based on them (transference: experiencing others as harsh judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding to their self-blame in a gentle, Empathetic tone, first acknowledging their emotions and needs, then inviting evidence examination and reality testing; avoiding judgment, using open-ended Questioning and concretizing Guidance.

manifestations: Hard to open up to friends about feelings of failure
outcomes: Seeking outside validation but Relationship tension

manifestations: Highly ties self-worth to the project's success or failure; success is seen as a fluke, failure is seen as the truth
Ignoring the positive side and growth when reviewing work

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: States 'I should have done better' and 'I missed an obvious problem'
Equating success and failure with personal worth, forming rigid success standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Attributing failure entirely to oneself, Persistent self-doubt
In new projects, procrastinates and struggles to engage for fear of failure

positive_force: Has developed several popular websites (objectively there are successful experiences and positive feedback)
Willing to actively participate in counseling, positive attitude, willing to try reality testing and gratitude practice
Able to identify the value of learning and skill improvement in failure
Has a few supportive friends who can provide support
negative_force: Mental filtering and negating the positive, over-focusing on failure cases
Self-doubt and attributing failure entirely to oneself
Excessively seeking external validation, leading to Interpersonal tension
Anxiety causing Sleep disturbance, affecting Work motivation and efficiency
Procrastinates in new projects, avoiding the risk of facing possible failure

target_behavior.behavior: Procrastinating and struggling to engage in new projects
antecedent: Starting or preparing to start a new website project
Continuing Work after the latest project's poor performance
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic Anticipation of failure and cognitive biases (mental filtering, negating the positive) triggering ability doubts and Anxiety
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and external evaluation, temporarily relieving Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Delayed project progress, declining professional Self-efficacy

antecedent: When project outcomes fall short of expectations
target_behavior.core_reason: Unstable inner sense of value, needing others' recognition to confirm ability and value
target_behavior.function: Relieving unease and Self-doubt through others' Approval
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with friends, emotions easily fluctuating with others' feedback

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep affected by Anxiety (Difficulty falling asleep, excessive rumination)
antecedent: Worrying about the new project's outcome
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessive focus on failure and self-blame triggering Persistent anxiety
target_behavior.function: A physiological manifestation of Anxiety, not instrumental functional behavior
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep patterns disrupted, insufficient energy the next day, further affecting Work motivation and efficiency
